def decide(bars, account):
    """Fast 10-day MA entry, slower 20-day MA exit, both with rising/falling confirmation."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 25:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    fast = sum(closes[-10:]) / 10
    fast_prior = sum(closes[-15:-5]) / 10
    slow = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    slow_prior = sum(closes[-25:-5]) / 20
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > fast and fast > fast_prior:
            return "BUY", "close above rising 10-day average"
    else:
        if price < slow and slow < slow_prior:
            return "SELL", "close below falling 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold while close is above a rising 20-day average; exit when it falls below a falling one."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 25:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    prior_average = sum(closes[-25:-5]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    rising = average > prior_average
    falling = average < prior_average
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average and rising:
        return "BUY", "close above a rising 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average and falling:
        return "SELL", "close below a falling 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"

v001seed · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2025-12-12 (278 sessions): -8.40% vs buy & hold -2.10% (alpha -6.29 pp)
Starting strategy supplied by the researcher and identical for every run; you did not write it. It is deliberately simple. Judge it on the evidence like any other version.
def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
